observations: Forecast fifty sent all one hundred; forecast seventy sent none under the shared threshold rule.
One hundred independent sixty-percent attendance nights averaged 60.2 people with 48 percent crowded.
Screenshot showed nightly bars around the sixty threshold, with crowded nights colored separately.

Reveal retains both forecast outcomes and sampled counts, distinguishes sample 48 percent from stated long-run 46.2 percent, and explains average versus crowding frequency. Reset after reveal did not erase the retained longest-run evidence.

whyCool: A forecast can change the very behavior it predicts, and an accurate average can still hide frequent overcrowding.
caveat: Fixed homogeneous decision rule and independent attendance model; long-run rate not independently audited.
